figurative_meaning_en: Insulting someone by mentioning or invoking their caste
similar_in_english: Hitting below the belt with ethnic slurs
example_sentences_in_bangla: রাগের মあまり সে তার প্রতিপক্ষের জাত তোলে।
এই বিতর্কে কেউ কেউ জাত তোলার চেষ্টা করে।
example_sentences_in_english: In anger, he brings up his opponent's caste to insult him.
During the debate, some try to resort to caste-based insults.
note: This idiom reflects the deep-seated caste sensitivities in Bengali society, often used in heated exchanges.
